title: ActivatedTextPreview
description:
Bounded activation-time visibility of one semantic unit's text.

Inline previews are planning material taken from represented normalized text. Unavailable content requires later typed hydration and is not read during activation.

oneOf.description: Bounded normalized text was available directly in the projection.

truncated.description: Whether represented normalized text continued beyond this preview.

oneOf.description:
The projection carries only a deterministic hydration address.

Activation does not dereference that address.
